name: What factors determine the cost of waterproofing a bathroom?

mainEntity.name: What factors determine the cost of waterproofing a bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of bathroom waterproofing depends on the bathroom size, whether you are replacing a standard tub surround or building a custom walk-in shower, and the structural condition of the framing. Essential cost drivers include removing existing materials down to the studs, repairing any existing rot or water-damaged drywall, plumbing valve adjustments, and installing the membrane system itself. While a basic membrane application on sound walls is straightforward, repairing compromised subflooring or building custom features like shower benches and recessed niches adds labor and material costs to the rough-in scope.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on shower dimensions, custom features like benches or niches, the type of membrane system used, and whether rotted subfloors or framing require structural repair.
